title: Petra at first light
summary: Walk the Siq into the Treasury, climb to the Monastery, then see the rose-red city again by candlelight. Three days in one of the Middle East's great ancient places.

stops.name: Petra Visitor Centre and the Siq
stops.note: The Siq is a 1.2 km gorge walk, mostly flat. Wear shoes with grip.

stops.name: Al-Khazneh (the Treasury)
stops.note: The gorge opens straight onto the facade, so keep your camera ready.

stops.name: Street of Facades and the Royal Tombs
stops.note: Allow time to climb into the tombs and look back across the valley.

stops.name: Lunch around Wadi Musa
stops.note: Back in town for mezze and grilled chicken after the long morning.

stops.name: Colonnaded Street and the Great Temple
stops.note: A flat warm-up through the old city centre before the climb.

stops.name: Ad Deir (the Monastery)
stops.note: Around 800 rock-cut steps up. Carry water and go at your own pace.

stops.name: Monastery viewpoint
stops.note: A short scramble beyond the Monastery looks out over Wadi Araba.

stops.name: Dinner around Wadi Musa
stops.note: Tired legs, so keep the evening easy.

stops.name: Little Petra (Siq al-Barid)
stops.note: A smaller canyon of carved rooms a short drive north of Wadi Musa.

stops.name: Afternoon rest in Wadi Musa
stops.note: Recover before the evening walk.

stops.name: Candlelit Siq to the Treasury
stops.note: Petra by Night runs on set evenings, so check dates before you book.

title: Wadi Rum, slowly
summary: Red sand, sandstone arches and a night under more stars than you expected. Two slow days in Jordan's desert valley.

stops.name: Rum Village and the visitor centre
stops.note: Arrange your jeep and guide here, and pick up water.

stops.name: Khazali Canyon
stops.note: A narrow slot with ancient carvings, a short walk from the jeep.

stops.name: Burdah Rock Bridge
stops.note: A natural arch you can scramble up with a guide.

stops.name: Dunes at sunset
stops.note: Climb a soft red dune and watch the colours change.

itinerary.theme: Sunrise and the long way out

stops.name: Sunrise from camp
stops.note: Bring a jumper, because desert mornings are cold.

stops.name: Seven Pillars of Wisdom rock
stops.note: A landmark formation at the edge of the village.

stops.name: Lawrence's Spring (Ain Shelaaleh)
stops.note: A short climb to a small spring on the mountainside.

stops.name: Breakfast at camp
stops.note: Flatbread, eggs and sweet tea before the drive out.

title: Val d'Orcia in no hurry
summary: Cypress roads, pecorino and Brunello in the Tuscan hills south of Siena. Four slow days, mostly by car, with plenty of time at the table.

stops.name: Pienza old town
stops.note: A small Renaissance town; Piazza Pio II is the centre.

stops.name: Via dell'Amore and the town walls
stops.note: A short lane along the ramparts with views across the valley.

stops.name: Lunch around Pienza
stops.note: Pecorino from local shops and a plate of pici.

stops.name: Cappella di Vitaleta
stops.note: The classic cypress-ringed chapel near San Quirico d'Orcia.

stops.name: Montalcino old town and fortress
stops.note: Climb the Fortezza for views over the vineyards.

stops.name: Brunello tasting around Montalcino
stops.note: Many estates welcome visitors; book ahead.

stops.name: Abbey of Sant'Antimo
stops.note: A Romanesque abbey set among olive groves south of town.

stops.name: Bagno Vignoni
stops.note: A village built around a thermal pool in its main square.

stops.name: Rocca d'Orcia and Castiglione d'Orcia
stops.note: Fortified hill villages with long views of Monte Amiata.

stops.name: Lunch around Castiglione d'Orcia
stops.note: Simple Tuscan lunches in the old centre.

stops.name: Monticchiello
stops.note: A walled village just south of Pienza, good for an evening stroll.

stops.name: Montepulciano Piazza Grande
stops.note: Climb the main street to the top of the town.

stops.name: Vino Nobile cellars under the old town
stops.note: Several cantinas offer tastings in historic cellars.

stops.name: Tempio di San Biagio
stops.note: A Renaissance church standing alone below the walls.

title: Five villages, three days
summary: Colourful villages stacked above the Ligurian Sea, linked by trail, train and ferry. A compact coastal weekend with seafood and focaccia.

stops.name: Monterosso al Mare
stops.note: The widest beach of the five; start gently.

stops.name: Vernazza harbour and Doria Castle
stops.note: The little harbour square is the village's heart.

stops.name: Lunch around Vernazza harbour
stops.note: Anchovies and focaccia by the water.

stops.name: Sunset above Vernazza
stops.note: Walk up the trail toward Monterosso for the look back at the village.

stops.name: Corniglia
stops.note: The only village not on the water, reached by around 380 steps.

stops.name: Corniglia to Manarola trail
stops.note: Check which trails are open before you set out.

stops.name: Manarola viewpoint
stops.note: The classic photograph looks back from the rocks to the east of the harbour.

stops.name: Dinner around Manarola
stops.note: Local white wine and fresh fish.

stops.name: Riomaggiore
stops.note: Narrow streets running steeply down to a small marina.

stops.name: Boat between the villages
stops.note: A different view of the cliffs from the water.

stops.name: Lunch around Riomaggiore
stops.note: Seafood fritti and a glass of Sciacchetrà.

stops.name: Sentiero Azzurro sections
stops.note: Walk whichever stretches are open; others are by train.

title: Jaipur in pink and gold
summary: Palaces, forts and bazaars in Rajasthan's pink city. Four days of heritage, craft and thali lunches.

stops.name: Hawa Mahal
stops.note: View the honeycombed facade from the street opposite.

stops.name: City Palace
stops.note: Still partly a royal residence, with museums in the courtyards.

stops.name: Jantar Mantar
stops.note: Giant 18th-century astronomical instruments, a UNESCO site.

stops.name: Lunch around Johari Bazaar
stops.note: Try a Rajasthani thali near the jewellers' lanes.

stops.name: Amer Fort
stops.note: Hill fort with mirrored halls; allow a long morning.

stops.name: Panna Meena ka Kund
stops.note: A geometric stepwell near Amer.

stops.name: Jaigarh Fort
stops.note: Home to one of the world's largest cannons on wheels.

stops.name: Jal Mahal viewpoint
stops.note: The palace appears to float on Man Sagar Lake.

stops.name: Bapu Bazaar and Johari Bazaar
stops.note: Textiles, jewellery and juttis; bargain gently.

stops.name: Block printing in Sanganer
stops.note: Watch craftspeople print cloth by hand.

stops.name: Albert Hall Museum
stops.note: An Indo-Saracenic building in Ram Niwas Garden.

stops.name: Nahargarh Fort at dawn
stops.note: Look over the whole city from the ridge.

stops.name: Galta Ji temple complex
stops.note: Hilltop temples and pools with resident monkeys.

stops.name: Lunch around MI Road
stops.note: Dal baati churma and lassi.

stops.name: Evening at Chandpole Bazaar
stops.note: A smaller market to end the trip.

title: Engadin, five unhurried days
summary: Lakes, larch forests and painted villages in Switzerland's high valley. Rail-friendly days with a glacier walk and a mountain pass.

stops.name: Lake St. Moritz shoreline
stops.note: A flat loop of about 4 km around the lake.

stops.name: Segantini Museum
stops.note: Alpine landscapes painted by Giovanni Segantini.

stops.name: Muottas Muragl funicular
stops.note: A rail ride to a ridge above the lakes.

stops.name: Lake Silvaplana
stops.note: Wind in the afternoons makes it popular with kitesurfers.

stops.name: Sils Maria and the Nietzsche-Haus
stops.note: A small museum in the village where the philosopher spent summers.

stops.name: Fex Valley
stops.note: A gentle valley walk by horse carriage or on foot.

stops.name: Lunch around Sils Maria
stops.note: Engadin barley soup and nut cake.

stops.name: Pontresina
stops.note: A mountain village with a historic centre.

stops.name: Rhaetian Railway Bernina line
stops.note: A UNESCO-listed line over the Bernina Pass.

stops.name: Morteratsch Glacier trail
stops.note: A signed walk with markers showing how far the ice has retreated.

stops.name: Guarda
stops.note: A village of sgraffito-decorated houses.

stops.name: Scuol and its spa
stops.note: Thermal baths fed by mineral springs.

stops.name: Swiss National Park near Zernez
stops.note: Marked trails through protected valleys.

stops.name: Samedan
stops.note: A relaxed village and the valley's historic seat.

stops.name: Zuoz
stops.note: One of the valley's best-preserved old villages.

stops.name: Maloja Pass
stops.note: The road drops in tight switchbacks toward Italy.

title: Sinaia and the Carpathians
summary: A royal castle and a cable car above the pines. Two slow days in Romania's mountain resort, an easy trip from Bucharest.

stops.name: Peles Castle
stops.note: A Neo-Renaissance castle built for King Carol I.

stops.name: Pelisor Castle
stops.note: A smaller, more intimate royal house nearby.

stops.name: Sinaia Monastery
stops.note: Founded in 1695 and the source of the town's name.

stops.name: Lunch around Bulevardul Carol I
stops.note: Cafes and bakeries along the main street.

stops.name: Cota 1400 by cable car
stops.note: The ride climbs steeply through forest.

stops.name: Bucegi plateau and Babele rocks
stops.note: Wind-sculpted rocks above the tree line.

stops.name: Sphinx rock formation
stops.note: A natural landmark on the high plateau.

stops.name: Sinaia Casino
stops.note: A 1912 building near the park, for a last look.

title: Lisbon on seven hills
summary: Tiled facades, yellow trams and river light across a hilly city. A three-day first look at Lisbon, with time for custard tarts.

stops.name: Miradouro das Portas do Sol
stops.note: A terrace over Alfama's rooftops and the Tagus.

stops.name: Castelo de São Jorge
stops.note: A hilltop castle with views across the whole city.

stops.name: Alfama lanes and the Sé cathedral
stops.note: Steep, narrow streets; wear shoes with grip.

stops.name: Dinner around Alfama
stops.note: Grilled sardines and fado in the evening, if you like.

stops.name: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
stops.note: A Manueline monastery and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

stops.name: Torre de Belém
stops.note: A 16th-century tower on the riverbank.

stops.name: Custard tarts in Belém
stops.note: The neighbourhood is known for pastéis de nata.

stops.name: LX Factory
stops.note: A former industrial site now full of shops and cafes.

stops.name: Praça do Comércio
stops.note: A grand riverside square at the foot of the Baixa grid.

stops.name: Elevador de Santa Justa
stops.note: An iron lift linking Baixa and Chiado.

stops.name: Lunch around Mercado da Ribeira
stops.note: A big food hall by Cais do Sodre with many stalls.

stops.name: Miradouro de Santa Catarina
stops.note: An easy-going terrace for a sunset drink.

title: Seville in orange blossom
summary: Moorish palaces, tapas bars and flamenco in Andalusia's capital. Three easy days built around long lunches and slow walks.

stops.name: Seville Cathedral and the Giralda
stops.note: Climb the ramps of the Giralda tower for a view over the old town.

stops.name: Real Alcázar
stops.note: A royal palace with Mudejar rooms and layered gardens.

stops.name: Lunch around Barrio Santa Cruz
stops.note: Tapas in the old Jewish quarter's narrow lanes.

stops.name: Evening walk by the Guadalquivir
stops.note: A flat promenade along the river.

stops.name: Plaza de España
stops.note: A semicircular plaza with tiled alcoves for each province.

stops.name: Parque de Maria Luisa
stops.note: Shady paths running alongside the plaza.

stops.name: Lunch around Mercado de Triana
stops.note: A market by the river, with tapas bars beside it.

stops.name: Flamenco in Triana
stops.note: The district where flamenco has deep roots.

stops.name: Metropol Parasol (Las Setas)
stops.note: A wooden structure with a walkway above the old town.

stops.name: Casa de Pilatos
stops.note: A palace mixing Mudejar, Gothic and Renaissance styles.

stops.name: Tapas around Alameda de Hercules
stops.note: A lively square for an evening round of small plates.

title: Dubrovnik walls and islands
summary: Limestone streets, medieval walls and a ferry to a small island. A compact Adriatic weekend.

stops.name: Dubrovnik city walls
stops.note: A circuit of about 2 km; carry water.

stops.name: Stradun
stops.note: The main street running through the old town.

stops.name: Rector's Palace
stops.note: A Gothic-Renaissance palace and city museum.

stops.name: Onofrio's Large Fountain
stops.note: A 15th-century fountain by the Pile Gate.

itinerary.theme: Above the city and across the water

stops.name: Mount Srd cable car
stops.note: The view takes in the old town and the Elaphiti Islands.

stops.name: Lokrum Island by ferry
stops.note: A short crossing to a wooded island with a small monastery.

stops.name: Banje Beach
stops.note: A city beach just outside the old town walls.

stops.name: Elaphiti Islands boat day
stops.note: Koločep, Lopud and Šipan are the usual stops.

stops.name: Lunch on Lopud
stops.note: Seafood near the island's sandy bay.

stops.name: Fort Lovrijenac
stops.note: A fortress outside the walls with views back at the city.

title: Prague, old town to castle
summary: Gothic spires, cobbled lanes and a castle above the river. Three easy days on foot, with beer halls and bridge views.

stops.name: Old Town Square and the Astronomical Clock
stops.note: The clock chimes on the hour.

stops.name: Charles Bridge
stops.note: A medieval stone bridge lined with statues.

stops.name: Josefov (Jewish Quarter)
stops.note: Synagogues and an old cemetery in the old ghetto.

stops.name: Prague Castle and St. Vitus Cathedral
stops.note: A large complex; allow a long morning.

stops.name: Golden Lane
stops.note: Tiny coloured cottages within the castle grounds.

stops.name: Lunch around Mala Strana
stops.note: Cafes and beer halls below the castle.

stops.name: Petrin Hill and its lookout tower
stops.note: Take the funicular up and walk down through orchards.

stops.name: Vyšehrad fortress
stops.note: Ramparts with views over the Vltava.

stops.name: Dancing House
stops.note: A modern riverside building by Frank Gehry and Vlado Milunic.

stops.name: Naplavka riverside
stops.note: A promenade along the embankment with cafes.

stops.name: Lunch around Vinohrady
stops.note: Czech and international cooking in a residential district.

title: Lofoten under winter light
summary: Red fishing cabins under sharp peaks, far inside the Arctic Circle. Five slow days with a chance of northern lights in winter.

stops.name: Svolvær harbour
stops.note: The main town in the islands, with a busy waterfront.

stops.name: Svolværgeita viewpoint
stops.note: The goat-horned peak is visible from the harbour.

stops.name: Kabelvag
stops.note: A small, old fishing village a short drive away.

stops.name: Lunch around Svolvær harbour
stops.note: Fish soup or stockfish dishes by the water.

stops.name: Henningsvaer
stops.note: A fishing village built across several small islands.

stops.name: Henningsvaer football pitch
stops.note: A pitch perched on a rock beside the sea.

stops.name: Haukland and Uttakleiv beaches
stops.note: White sand on the island's north-west coast.

stops.name: Ramberg beach
stops.note: A long curve of pale sand under the mountains.

stops.name: Flakstad church
stops.note: A red wooden church dating back to the 1780s.

stops.name: Hamnøy
stops.note: Red cabins on rocky islets, popular for photographs.

stops.name: Reinebringen steps
stops.note: A steep stair of about 2,000 steps with a big view.

stops.name: Reine village
stops.note: Cabins and drying racks around a sheltered harbour.

stops.name: A i Lofoten
stops.note: The road's end, with a stockfish museum.

stops.name: Nusfjord
stops.note: A preserved fishing village and UNESCO site.

stops.name: Lofotr Viking Museum at Borg
stops.note: A reconstructed chieftain's longhouse.

stops.name: Northern lights evening
stops.note: Seen from September to April in clear conditions.

title: Dolomites, valley to ridge
summary: Pale limestone towers, alpine meadows and wooden huts. Five days of easy-to-moderate walks across South Tyrol and Veneto.

stops.name: Ortisei
stops.note: The main village of Val Gardena, known for woodcarving.

stops.name: Seceda ridge by cable car
stops.note: A jagged ridge above green meadows.

stops.name: Lunch at a mountain hut
stops.note: Dumplings and strudel on the trail.

stops.name: Alpe di Siusi (Seiser Alm)
stops.note: One of Europe's largest high-altitude meadows, with gentle paths.

stops.name: Castelrotto
stops.note: A pretty village with a bell tower and old inns.

stops.name: Sunset on the plateau
stops.note: The Sassolungo and Sciliar peaks catch the last light.

stops.name: Tre Cime circuit
stops.note: A loop of roughly 10 km, mostly well signed.

stops.name: Lago di Misurina
stops.note: A mountain lake on the road up to the Tre Cime.

stops.name: Auronzo hut stop
stops.note: Refuel at the trailhead before or after the walk.

stops.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
stops.note: The valley's main town, set among the peaks.

stops.name: Lago di Braies
stops.note: A green lake ringed by easy paths.

stops.name: Lunch around Cortina
stops.note: Ladin and Venetian dishes in the valley.

stops.name: Lago di Carezza
stops.note: A small lake with the Latemar peaks mirrored in it.

stops.name: South Tyrol Museum of Archaeology
stops.note: Home to the Iceman, Otzi.

stops.name: Lunch around Piazza Walther
stops.note: Alpine and Italian food in Bolzano's centre.

title: Porto and the Douro
summary: Port lodges, terraced vineyards and a slow river train. Four days from Porto into one of the oldest wine regions in Europe.

stops.name: Ribeira district
stops.note: Colourful old houses on the Douro's north bank.

stops.name: Dom Luis I Bridge
stops.note: Cross the upper deck for the sweep of both banks.

stops.name: Palacio da Bolsa
stops.note: A 19th-century stock exchange with an ornate Arab Room.

stops.name: Port lodges in Vila Nova de Gaia
stops.note: Tastings in the cellars across the river.

stops.name: São Bento station
stops.note: Azulejo tile panels in the main hall.

stops.name: Douro line to Pinhao
stops.note: A scenic rail trip following the river.

stops.name: Pinhao station tiles
stops.note: Blue-and-white panels showing the wine harvest.

stops.name: Quinta tasting around Pinhao
stops.note: Many estates offer tastings by appointment.

stops.name: São Leonardo de Galafura viewpoint
stops.note: Terraces fall away to the river below.

stops.name: Museu do Douro in Peso da Regua
stops.note: The story of the region and its wine.

stops.name: River cruise from Pinhao
stops.note: A gentle trip between the terraced banks.

stops.name: Amarante
stops.note: A riverside town with a stone bridge and a monastery.

stops.name: Lunch around Amarante
stops.note: Local cakes and regional cooking.

stops.name: Last evening in Porto
stops.note: A relaxed dinner before departure.

title: Santorini, caldera days
summary: White villages on a volcanic rim above a deep blue bay. Four easy days on one of the Aegean's well-known islands.

stops.name: Fira old town
stops.note: Narrow lanes along the caldera edge.

stops.name: Three Bells of Fira
stops.note: A well-known view over the caldera.

stops.name: Cable car down to Old Port
stops.note: The alternative is a long stair of donkey steps.

stops.name: Fira to Oia caldera walk
stops.note: Around 10 km along the rim; bring water and a hat.

stops.name: Oia castle ruins
stops.note: Ruins long used as a sunset viewpoint.

stops.name: Dinner around Oia
stops.note: Seafood with a caldera view.

stops.name: Akrotiri archaeological site
stops.note: A Bronze Age town preserved under volcanic ash.

stops.name: Red Beach
stops.note: Red cliffs above a small pebble beach.

stops.name: Lunch around Akrotiri
stops.note: Tavernas by the water.

stops.name: Pyrgos village
stops.note: A hilltop village with a ruined castle.

stops.name: Wine tasting around Megalochori
stops.note: Santorini's assyrtiko is the island's signature white.

stops.name: Profitis Ilias monastery
stops.note: The island's highest area, with views across the island.

title: Kyoto, temple mornings
summary: Wooden temples, moss gardens and lantern-lit lanes. Five days in Japan's old capital, with a morning for each great district.

stops.name: Kiyomizu-dera
stops.note: A wooden hillside temple with a large stage over the valley.

stops.name: Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka lanes
stops.note: Preserved streets of shops and teahouses.

stops.name: Yasaka Shrine and Gion
stops.note: Wander the old geisha district in the evening.

stops.name: Lunch around Gion
stops.note: Kyoto-style set meals and soba.

stops.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
stops.note: Thousands of vermilion gates climb the hill.

stops.name: Tofuku-ji
stops.note: A Zen temple known for its autumn maple gorge.

stops.name: Fushimi sake district
stops.note: Tastings in an old brewing quarter.

stops.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
stops.note: A short path through tall bamboo.

stops.name: Tenryu-ji
stops.note: A Zen temple with a pond garden.

stops.name: Togetsukyo Bridge
stops.note: A long wooden-style bridge over the Katsura River.

stops.name: Lunch around Arashiyama
stops.note: Tofu and yuba dishes.

stops.name: Kinkaku-ji
stops.note: The gold-leaf pavilion beside its mirror pond.

stops.name: Ryoan-ji
stops.note: A famous dry rock garden.

stops.name: Nishiki Market
stops.note: A narrow covered market of pickles, tofu and snacks.

stops.name: Nanzen-ji
stops.note: A temple with a large brick aqueduct in its grounds.

stops.name: Philosopher's Path
stops.note: A canal-side path lined with cherry trees.

stops.name: Ginkaku-ji
stops.note: The Silver Pavilion and its raked sand garden.

stops.name: Heian Shrine
stops.note: A vermilion shrine with a large garden, a short walk from Nanzen-ji.

title: Hanoi, street by street
summary: Motorbikes, lakeside mornings and bowls of pho on low stools. Four easy days in Vietnam's capital and a day among the karst hills.

stops.name: Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple
stops.note: A loop of the lake, with a small temple on an island.

stops.name: Old Quarter streets
stops.note: Each street historically traded a single craft.

stops.name: Dong Xuan Market
stops.note: A wholesale market with street food in the lanes around it.

stops.name: Long Bien Bridge
stops.note: An old iron bridge over the Red River.

itinerary.theme: Ho Chi Minh complex and the Temple of Literature

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum area
stops.note: Dress modestly; the site has strict rules.

stops.name: One Pillar Pagoda
stops.note: A small wooden pagoda on a single pillar.

stops.name: Temple of Literature
stops.note: Vietnam's first national university, founded in 1070.

stops.name: Hoa Lo Prison Museum
stops.note: A history museum in the former prison.

stops.name: Trang An landscape complex
stops.note: Boat trips through caves under limestone towers.

stops.name: Tam Coc boat ride
stops.note: Rowing between rice fields and karst hills.

stops.name: Hoa Lu ancient capital
stops.note: Temples of the 10th-century capital.

stops.name: Tran Quoc Pagoda
stops.note: The city's oldest Buddhist temple, on a lake islet.

stops.name: West Lake shore
stops.note: Cafes and flat paths around the lake.

stops.name: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology
stops.note: Houses and displays from Vietnam's 54 ethnic groups.

stops.name: Egg coffee around the Old Quarter
stops.note: A local specialty made with whipped yolk.

title: Ubud and the rice terraces
summary: Rice terraces, temples and craft villages in Bali's cultural heart. Six slow days in the hills.

stops.name: Ubud Palace
stops.note: A royal complex with evening dance performances.

stops.name: Ubud Market
stops.note: Spices, textiles and snacks along the central streets.

stops.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
stops.note: A forest with temples and macaques; keep food hidden.

stops.name: Tegallalang rice terraces
stops.note: Terraces tilting down the valley side.

stops.name: Tirta Empul
stops.note: A water temple where visitors take part in purification rituals.

stops.name: Lunch around Tegallalang
stops.note: Warungs with terrace views.

stops.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
stops.note: A paved ridge path through grass and palms.

stops.name: Neka Art Museum
stops.note: Balinese and international art.

stops.name: Evening around Ubud
stops.note: Balinese dishes such as babi guling or vegetarian options.

stops.name: Mount Batur trek
stops.note: A pre-dawn climb for a sunrise over the caldera.

stops.name: Kintamani viewpoint
stops.note: A rim overlook above Lake Batur.

stops.name: Hot springs at Toya Bungkah
stops.note: Soak tired legs by the lake.

stops.name: Tirta Gangga water palace
stops.note: A royal garden of pools and stepping stones.

stops.name: Sidemen valley
stops.note: A terraced valley with weaving villages.

stops.name: Lunch around Sidemen
stops.note: Simple local dishes by the paddies.

stops.name: Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave)
stops.note: An 11th-century cave sanctuary.

stops.name: Tegenungan Waterfall
